data.one_liner: Mediation adapter for Liftoff Monetize in the Google Mobile Ads plugin
data.what_it_does: Enables sending ad requests to the LiftoffMonetize ad network using the google_mobile_ads plugin. It bridges the Google Mobile Ads SDK with Liftoff Monetize for ad mediation on Android and iOS.
use_when: You are using google_mobile_ads and want to mediate ads through Liftoff Monetize
You need to display Liftoff Monetize ads via Google Mobile Ads SDK in Flutter
avoid_when: You are not using the google_mobile_ads plugin
You do not use ad mediation networks in your application
strengths: Official Google Mobile Ads mediation adapter plugin
weaknesses: Requires proper setup of both Google Mobile Ads and Liftoff Monetize SDKs natively
data.setup_notes: Requires configuration according to the Google Mobile Ads developer guide for Liftoff Monetize mediation.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only want base Google Mobile Ads without the Liftoff Monetize mediation adapter.

alternatives.name: applovin_max
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using AppLovin MAX as your ad mediation platform instead of Google Mobile Ads mediation.
